messages:
Lana: Quick heads-up — I'm about to merge the Optimize Toolkit docs PR but there's a small checklist I'd like a quick eyeball on (batching examples + quant profile table + two broken links).
Ryan: which links are broken? can do a quick pass now. :mag:
Lana: one is in the SDK snippet section (old param name) and the other is the migration note anchor. PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — ci failed on linting but not related to content.
Ryan: saw the PR, loading locally. I can update the SDK snippet to reflect `batch_config` -> `batching` rename.
Zara: ping me on the quant profiles table — I think the float16/8 recommendations need clearer wording for small-batch low-latency setups. Also we should add an explicit example showing `prefetch_kv: true` + small batch size.
Lana: agreed. can you add the example and a one-liner explaining the tradeoff? short wording preferred.
Zara: sure. proposed snippet (md fenced):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${{REDWOOD_KEY}}")
resp = client.generate("Summarize this...",
    model="rw-opt-2b",
    batching={"max_batch_size":4, "max_latency_ms":30},
    cache={"kv_prefetch": true}
)
print(resp.text)
```
Zara: note in prose: "Enable kv prefetch when your workload has repeated prefixes and tight latency SLOs; reduces repeat attention compute at the cost of slightly higher memory footprints."
Ryan: lgtm. for the migration note anchor I can add a redirect from `/optimize/migration#old-anchors` to the new section to avoid 404s.
Lana: thanks — can you also run the doc linter? docs-bot reported one trailing space in `optimize/batching.md` earlier.
docs-bot: automated-checks — spellcheck: passed; markdown-lint: failed (trailing-whitespace in optimize/batching.md line 84); link-checker: 2 broken links found (optimize/sdk-snippets -> /sdk/old-batch, optimize/migration#profiles-anchor).
Ryan: fixed the trailing whitespace and pushed a tiny commit. updated the SDK snippet param names.
Zara: pushed quant wording + example. I added the prefetch note and a small table row suggested for 1-8 tokens typical inference.
Lana: awesome. one final ask — add a short compatibility note for Dedicated/private deployments about HSM key support for caching metadata. small sentence under caching section.
Ryan: adding that now.
Lana: ok once CI is green i'll merge. thanks y'all :rocket:
